data.name: UploadIntro
data.value: Choose the document type, one file or several images, and a document name, then upload. The document page opens as soon as the upload is done.

data.name: FolderPrompt
data.value: Or use every image in a folder, in file name order:

data.name: FolderSkipped
data.value: {0} file(s) in the folder were skipped because they are not supported images.

data.name: FolderTooManyFiles
data.value: The folder has {0} images; a document can have at most {1} pages.

data.name: FolderTooLarge
data.value: The folder has more than {0} files. Choose a smaller folder.

data.name: DropZonePrompt
data.value: Drag and drop a file here, or click to browse

data.name: Mode.Multi.Hint
data.value: Up to {0} images, combined into one PDF (one page per image).

data.name: DropZonePrompt.Multi
data.value: Drag and drop images here, or click to browse

data.name: DropZoneHint.Multi
data.value: {0} · up to {1} images · up to {2} MB in total

data.name: OneFileOnly
data.value: Choose a single file, or switch to Multi to combine several images into one document.

data.name: Selected.ReplaceHint
data.value: Pages are in file name order; use the arrows to change it. Choosing files again replaces the list.

data.name: UnexpectedError
data.value: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

data.name: PagesPending
data.value: Pages appear here as they finish. Most pages complete together at the last step.

data.name: Toast.Queued
data.value: Sent to the OCR service, waiting in queue

data.name: ocr.file_name_too_long
data.value: File name must not exceed {0} characters.

data.name: ocr.content_mismatch
data.value: The file is not a supported document or does not match its extension.

data.name: ocr.not_ready
data.value: The result is not ready yet.

data.name: ocr.service_unavailable
data.value: The OCR service is not available right now.

data.name: ocr.file_name_invalid
data.value: The file name must not contain / \ : * ? " < > | or control characters.

data.name: ocr.too_many_pages
data.value: A document can have at most {0} pages.

data.name: ocr.unsupported_page_format
data.value: Only {0} images can be combined into one document.

data.name: ocr.image_not_supported
data.value: One of the images cannot be added as a page (for example an interlaced PNG). Save it again as a standard JPG or PNG.

data.name: JobError.unauthorized
data.value: The OCR service rejected the API key. Check the configuration.

data.name: JobError.not_found
data.value: The OCR service could not find this job.

data.name: JobError.file_too_large
data.value: The file is larger than 25 MB.

data.name: JobError.too_many_pages
data.value: The document has more than 20 pages. Split it and upload again.

data.name: JobError.unsupported_file
data.value: The OCR service does not support this file type.

data.name: JobError.bad_image
data.value: The file is damaged, password-protected or has no pages.

data.name: JobError.invalid_request
data.value: The OCR service rejected the request.

data.name: JobError.internal_error
data.value: The OCR service hit an unexpected error.

data.name: JobError.processing_error
data.value: Processing failed on the OCR service. Upload the file again to retry.

data.name: JobError.service_unavailable
data.value: The OCR service could not be reached.

data.name: JobError.remote_job_lost
data.value: The OCR service no longer has this job (it may have been restarted).

data.name: JobError.file_download_failed
data.value: The OCR service could not download the file from this application. Try again; if it keeps failing, check the configuration.

data.name: Warning.Repeated
data.value: The full-page read repeated itself; the page was read block by block (slower).

data.name: Warning.AllRepeated
data.value: Every full-page read repeated itself; the text may be incomplete.

data.name: Warning.LayoutSmaller
data.value: Layout detection failed at the usual size and was redone at a smaller size.

data.name: Warning.NoBlocks
data.value: No text block was found; the whole page was treated as one block.

data.name: Warning.NothingReadable
data.value: Every reading method failed; the text is only the readable part and is almost certainly incomplete.

data.name: Warning.KrakenFailed
data.value: Line detection failed; a fallback method was used.

data.name: Warning.LayoutOom
data.value: Layout ran out of GPU memory when enlarged and was redone at the original size.

data.name: Warning.ChandraFailed
data.value: One of the four handwriting readings could not run; the result was chosen from the other three.

data.name: Warning.GpuRetry
data.value: A temporary GPU error occurred; the page was read again and the result is normal.

data.name: DeleteNote
data.value: This removes the document and what was saved for it in this app (review status, metadata, versions). The OCR service only cancels jobs that are still queued; running or finished jobs stay on the service and can appear again in the list.

data.name: ListFromMemoryNotice
data.value: The OCR service cannot list jobs yet, so this shows jobs sent from this app since the server last started. Open older jobs by their id.

data.name: SearchPlaceholder
data.value: Search by file name or job id

data.name: SearchLimited
data.value: Only the newest {0} jobs were searched.

data.name: ocr.job_busy
data.value: The OCR service is reading this document or finishing its Word file. Try again when it is done.

data.name: ocr.last_page
data.value: The only page of a document cannot be deleted. Delete the document instead.

data.name: ocr.page_not_found
data.value: The document has no such page. Reload the page and try again.

data.name: ocr.pages_not_editable
data.value: The pages of a cancelled document cannot be changed.
